measurement: spd-w18-plus-creates-without-navigating c0 — BOTH desk steps (Structure row select, and the "+") across 10 consecutive COLD runs
criterion: c0 — Both desk steps (Structure row select, and the "+") land on a SINGLE press across 10 consecutive cold runs, and the per-step latencies are quoted.
served_sha_note: the harness's own PRE/POST served-commit stamp; pre == post on all 10 runs, and the SAME sha on every run, so no deploy landed mid-measurement. NOT the sibling row's 1b3856eed — a deploy landed on guerrilla at 2026-09-22T04:44Z.
viewport: headless Chrome --headless=new, --window-size=1500,1000 as journey.mjs passes it; Chrome/153.0.8010.53, node v22.22.0, darwin arm64

instrument.invocation: TMPDIR=<fresh empty dir> node tooling/studio-journey/journey.mjs --report --json --legs a --out run<N>.json
instrument.reused_not_rebuilt: the harness shipped by PR #16603 (41de602a0). Nothing was built for this criterion. The sibling row spd-w18-desk-click-latency measured the #item-paper half of this with the same instrument (PR #19755, 38c4dfa32); this adds the "+" half and requires BOTH.
instrument.reading: the CREATE beat reports, per step, the latency, the ATTEMPT COUNT from Page.clickUntil, and the three-valued wire verdict off Chrome Network.webSocketFrameSent.

result.wire: SENT with exactly 1 "type":"click" frame for EACH step on EVERY run (20 steps, 20 frames)

controls.name: COLD is observed, not asserted
controls.how: every run got its own directory, created empty by the driver and verified entries_before=0 before launch (recorded per run below). A separately watched 11th run polled the directory at 2 Hz DURING the run.
controls.observation: the profile appeared at t=0.0s as studio-journey-tighxU with NO Default/Cookies file present and 0 cache files; the cache climbed 0 -> 31 (t=0.6s) -> 82 (t=1.2s) -> 89 (t=3.5s); dir_entries returned to 0 at t=25.4s after teardown.
controls.corroboration: journey.mjs mints a fresh single-use 60s login ticket per run and redeems it; the admin discriminator ([phx-click=shares-open] == 1) passed on every run, so the session cookie is that run's own and not one carried across.

controls.name: NO-RETRY — an absence is never caught by inspection
controls.mutation: M-RETRY-PLUS, applied to the OFFLINE self-test fixture's new-document handler: `if ((window.__mSwallowFirstPlus = (window.__mSwallowFirstPlus||0)+1) === 1) return;` so the FIRST "+" press is swallowed.
controls.before: the + navigates to a NEW document id — paper-fx2 in 0.2s after 1 press(es)
controls.after: the + navigates to a NEW document id — paper-fx2 in 5.2s after 2 press(es)
controls.reads: both the attempt counter and the latency move, on the same clickUntil path that reports the live numbers, so "1 press(es)" is a reading and not a constant.
controls.reverted: yes — `git checkout --` then `cmp` against a pre-mutation copy taken before the edit: identical. The mutation does not ship.

controls.name: CAN-IT-FAIL — a green is only a result if it could have gone red
controls.offline: self-test executes 134 assertions (floor 40) and exits good=0, rot=1.
controls.live: ONE evaluate_script on the deployed desk — armed and read in the SAME evaluation, never split across two calls — set data-phx-ref-src on the "+" itself, pressed, polled 8s; then removed the attribute and pressed THE SAME BUTTON ON THE SAME PAGE.
controls.side_finding_for_c2: the SWALLOWED ARM 1 press created NOTHING. A drafts-perspective query ordered by _createdAt:desc immediately afterwards shows exactly one new document in that window — ARM 2's. On e02e4296d the client-side discard is a pure discard, not a silent create.

verdict.c0: the criterion's measurement is satisfied on e02e4296d: 10/10 consecutive cold runs landed BOTH desk steps on a single press, latencies quoted above.
verdict.what_this_does_not_say: this is a MEASURE case, not a FIX case. Nothing was changed to make it pass. The row's history (6.1s / 15.0s / 20.0s, 2-3 presses, no flash, presses that created drafts without navigating, measured on e4ed31a10 / 4f046cce1 / 25e69158a in July) is not reproducible on e02e4296d. The defect was not fixed by this work; it is not present on the build now served.
honest_reds: run 6's PERSIST beat FAILED — 'Autosave did not reach the server' after 20.1s, 44.0s wall against ~25s typical. That beat is downstream of CREATE; run 6's two desk steps still landed on one press each (1.1s / 3.3s).

the measuring laptop was at load average 35 from sibling lanes. Two runs hung in Chrome's CDP attach for over 9 minutes and were killed and redone serially under a 120s timeout; a further set of runs was quarantined for having raced a second driver loop. Those are ENVIRONMENT, not product, and none of them contributes a number above.
